# Plants vs. Zombies Widescreen

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Twig-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Twig6943/PvZWidescreenSteam) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-HenryJk-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/HenryJk/PvZWidescreen)

Plays Plants vs. Zombies in 16:9 instead of 4:3. Twig's version of HenryJk's mod, licensed under the GPL-3.0 (see [LICENSE](./LICENSE)).

## Before you install

- **Back up your save.** The mod runs an older version of the game (1.0.0.1051) that uses the same save and rewrites it in its older format. Removing the mod does not bring the lost part back. The save is usually in `C:\ProgramData\PopCap Games\PlantsVsZombies\userdata`.
- The Game of the Year extras (Zombatar and Achievements) are not available while the mod is installed.
- The picture is always 16:9. Other screen shapes are not supported.

## Install

Apply the mod. The original `PlantsVsZombies.exe` and `main.pak` are renamed to
`PlantsVsZombies.exe.pvz-original.bak` and `main.pak.pvz-original.bak`.

For manual installation, rename those two files yourself, then extract `PlantsVsZombies.exe`,
`main.pak` and `pvzgame.exe` from `PvZWidescreenForSteam.zip` into the game folder.

## Play

Start `PlantsVsZombies.exe`, not `pvzgame.exe`. Starting `pvzgame.exe` directly skips the widescreen patch.

## Remove

Unapply the mod to delete its files and restore the originals.
